notes: A single porous natural sea-sponge, dark and dripping wet, lashed with cord onto the very tip of one bare reed stalk, vinegar running off in a drip. There is NO cup, wine glass, goblet, bowl or vessel of any kind anywhere — the earlier embedded-wine-glass failure is fully gone; the reed tip carries only the bare soaked sponge. Matches 'filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it on a reed' (Matt 27:48 / John 19:29).
